definitions.explanation: In a state of good health, proper functioning, or moral soundness. Used for physical health, mental well-being, organizations, finances, and moral character.

examples.japanese: {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{健全|けんぜん}な⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧。
examples.english: A sound mind dwells in a sound body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{健全|けんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to keep finances sound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{青少年|せいしょうねん}→青少年：16559_seishounen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健全|けんぜん}な⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: The community is working to promote the wholesome development of young people.

notes:
A versatile word used across many contexts — physical health, mental health, organizational management, financial stability, and moral education. The phrase {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧ (wholesome upbringing) is common in educational and government discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (sound management)
- {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧ (sound finances)
- {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧ (healthy development)
- {健全|けんぜん}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (sound mind)
